entries.blurb: Portfolio sites often reduce months of work to a static paragraph that goes stale the moment the next commit lands. Built blurbot, a tool that turns a developer's recent GitHub commits into a portfolio-ready blurb — drafting it, self-critiquing the output against a style guide, and opening a PR automatically. Recent work expanded it to surface the top three active repos for a carousel-style display and added a local critique step that validates draft content against the style guide before a PR ever opens.
